note: The Bank of Tanzania (Credit Reference Bureau) Regulations, 2012, as the Bank publishes them: a bureau may not place adverse information more than six years after it was placed in the database or last reaffirmed. No source read states how many days after its due date a missed payment is reported, so the days are the game's reading: the bureau's next monthly update.

sources.title: Bank of Tanzania (Credit Reference Bureau) Regulations, 2012
sources.said: any adverse information where more than six years have expired since the adverse information was placed in the database or last reaffirmed
